points: After a gap, the E20 issue has once again surfaced in the country.

items.title: India overtakes Taiwan to become world’s fifth-largest stock market after $640-billion rebound
points: India’s stock market has regained its position as the world’s fifth-largest, with market capitalisation rising to $5.4 trillion.

India has regained its position as the world’s fifth-largest stock market, with the value of its listed equities rising to $5.4 trillion and overtaking Taiwan after a sharp rebound in domestic shares.
India’s market capitalisation has increased by around $640 billion since late October, as benchmark indices extended their gains.
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,255.05 on Wednesday, its highest level in more than eight months, and has risen 9.55 per cent so far in November.

Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) bought a net ₹65,735 crore worth of Indian equities in November through November 11, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) sold shares worth ₹40,504 crore, according to provisional exchange data.
This marks a reversal from October, when foreign investors sold a net ₹45,162 crore of equities.
Foreign investors withdrew $30.68 billion from Taiwanese equities and $14.59 billion from South Korean stocks in October, according to LSEG data.

items.title: Two lose nearly ₹1 crore in separate online trading frauds in Keralam’s Kozhikode
points: In two separate incidents of cyber fraud, a homemaker from Kodanchery and a farmer from Thiruvambadi, both in Kozhikode district of Keralam, lost ₹49.20 lakh and ₹49.10 lakh, respectively, after being lured into fake online trading schemes.
The Cyber Crime Police and the Thiruvambadi Police have registered cases and launched a joint investigation.
According to the police, the person from Kodanchery fell prey to a fraudulent investment scheme after being persuaded by a morphed video featuring Union Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Facebook.
The scammers convinced her that substantial financial returns could be generated through online trading.
In the second incident, the farmer, a former non-resident Indian (NRI), was allegedly defrauded through a fabricated video on YouTube.
The perpetrators duped him into believing that importing medical equipment from abroad into India would yield high profits, prompting him to transfer funds to accounts specified by the scammers.

items.title: Jewellery worth ₹12 crore stolen from Madhya Pradesh showroom, thieves break in through wall: Police
points: Jewellery worth nearly ₹12 crore was stolen from a showroom in Madhya Pradesh’s Katni after thieves broke through a wall and forced open the safe and display counters in the early hours of Thursday, police said.
According to police officers, the incident came to light on Thursday morning when the staff reached the showroom and found the safe and display counters broken open.
Showroom owner Mohan Bajaj said that jewellery worth ₹12 crore to ₹15 crore was kept in the showroom.
He said around ₹12 crore worth of jewellery was missing.
Police, however, said that the exact value of the stolen jewellery will be clear after audit of the records.
Katni superintendent of police (SP) Abhinav Vishwakarma inspected the showroom and said preliminary investigation suggested the theft took place between 4 am and 7 am on November 12.
The thieves made a hole in the wall to enter the showroom, indicating the crime was well-planned, he said.
Police have seized the footage from the CCTV cameras installed inside the showroom.

items.title: Can Son Claim Birthright In Father's Exclusive Property? What Supreme Court Said
points: A son cannot claim a birthright in his father's share of a property that has already been partitioned and become his father's exclusive property, the Supreme Court has held while dismissing an appeal seeking a half share in the property.
The court was examining whether a son could seek partition of his father's property during the latter's lifetime on the ground that it was ancestral or joint family property.
The case arose from a partition suit filed in 1997 on behalf of a minor son, through his mother, seeking half share in a property measuring 1,811 sqft.
The Supreme Court, however, noted that the grandfather's death and the opening of succession preceded the appellant's birth.
The grandfather's property was the subject of partition proceedings instituted in 1993 and the appellant was born on January 6, 1994, while a settlement was arrived at on February 3, 1994.
The court held that the grandfather's property had devolved upon his Class I heirs under the Hindu Succession Act, 1956.

Resident Evil Requiem took home four awards: Best Game Trailer (27% of votes), Console Game of the Year (27% of votes), Best Lead Performer for Angela Sant’Albano’s portrayal of Grace Ashcroft (36% of votes), and the night’s biggest honour, Ultimate Game…

The Ultimate Game of the Year race was tight at the Golden Joystick Awards 2026, with Crimson Desert and Phantom Blade Zero securing 15% and 16% of the votes, respectively, just behind Resident Evil Requiem’s 17%.
Meanwhile, Dispatch also won multiple awards after losing out on any wins despite being part of The Game Awards 2025 nominations.
In the 2026 Golden Joystick Awards, Dispatch won two awards: Best Soundtrack (26% of votes) and Best Storytelling.
The Best Storytelling category had multiple heavy-hitters, including 007 First Light, Silent Hill: Townfall, and more, but Dispatch took home the win.

items.title: ‘To stop BJP’s 3rd win’: AIMIM-Azad Samaj Party alliance names Chandra Shekhar Azad as UP CM candidate
points: The All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) and Azad Samaj Party (ASP) on Thursday announced an alliance for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections.
Speaking at a press conference in Lucknow on Thursday, AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi said the alliance has chosen ASP chief Chandra Shekhar Azad as its chief ministerial candidate.
"I am happy to announce our CM candidate as Chandra Shekhar Azad," Owaisi told reporters in Lucknow.
The AIMIM and ASP leaders also called for a rally on November 26.
Muslims account for around 20% of Uttar Pradesh’s population, while Dalits constitute approximately 21%.

Despite getting the cold shoulder from the Samajwadi Party and the Congress, which are currently engaged in seat-sharing negotiations, Owaisi and Azad have extended an invitation to the Opposition parties to join the alliance as part of their effort to…
AIMIM contested 95 seats and secured around 0.49% of the votes but failed to win any, while ASP contested more than 100 seats and polled roughly 0.13%.

items.title: Google Announces Gemini Intelligence for Android Auto With Proactive AI Suggestions
points: Gemini can connect information across apps to offer personalised recommendations while driving.

The company introduced Personal Intelligence on Android Auto Last month.
Google, in a blog post, confirmed that Gemini Intelligence will soon be available on Android Auto with proactive suggestions.
Gemini Intelligence will make the in-car assistant more proactive, and it can identify relevant details from connected apps and give suggestions that can be acted upon with a single tap.

It says that when a user receives a message from a friend asking about the location of an upcoming Pilates class, Gemini Intelligence on Android Auto can find the confirmation email and instantly suggest sending the address with a single tap, without…

items.title: Google Labs Launches Tabletop as an AI-Powered Collaborative Tool for Trips, Games and Group Activities
points: The Tabletop experience is currently rolling out in the US to users aged 18 and above through a waitlist.
Users can start by adding their links, files and ideas to a Tabletop space Google Labs announced a new experimental tool on Wednesday to help make group planning and collaboration more interactive.
According to the Mountain View-based tech giant, the new Tabletop experience lets users turn links, files and ideas into customisable spaces where multiple people can contribute in real time.
Google says it can be used for a wide range of activities, from organising family trips and splitting expenses to creating dinner polls, tournament brackets and household chore lists.
In a blog post, Google described Tabletop as a customisable collaborative space that allows groups to plan activities, share information and make decisions together.
The Tabletop experience is currently rolling out in the US to users aged 18 and above through a waitlist.
Availability in other markets, including India, remains under wraps.

items.title: Vivo X500 Series India Launch Date Announced; Will Debut Alongside Vivo Watch GT 2, Zeiss Telephoto Converter Kit
points: Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max will be launched in India on November 26, along with the new Vivo Watch GT 2 and the Zeiss telephoto converter kit, the company has announced.
The company has also revealed that the standard model will sport a “floating camera module” with a Zeiss-tuned imaging solution.
The handset will also feature AI-powered creative tools.
Meanwhile, the Vivo X500 Pro Max and Vivo X500 Pro will carry a Zeiss-tuned triple rear camera unit, housed inside a circular deco.
The Pro Max model will feature Telephoto AF Tracking Video and the ZEISS TrueDynamic Main Camera, the company announced.
On the other hand, the Vivo Watch GT 2 is confirmed to sport a 2.07-inch Ultra-Vision Display with always-on monitoring.
The smartwatch is claimed to deliver up to 25 days of battery life.

items.title: Volkswagen 2 Biggest Launches: One Is A Sedan, the Other Is A Sub-4 Meter SUV
points: The German automotive giant Volkswagen will soon be launching two new and very important cars in India.
The company originally launched the Virtus in India back in June 2022, and the sedan is now getting its first major update after more than four years.
The smaller engine produces 115 PS and 178 Nm of torque.
Meanwhile, the 1.5-litre unit generates 150 PS and 250 Nm.
As for pricing, the existing Virtus is priced between approximately Rs 10.71 lakh and Rs 19.20 lakh (ex-showroom).
The second and more important launch for Volkswagen will be its all-new sub-4-metre SUV.
Recently, Volkswagen Passenger Cars CEO Thomas Schäfer confirmed that the company will enter India's highly competitive compact SUV segment in 2027.
This all-new upcoming Volkswagen SUV will be based on the heavily localised MQB-A0-IN platform.

items.title: Arvind Kejriwal gets death threat from Lawrence Bishnoi gang, case filed in Mohali
points: The Lawrence Bishnoi gang has threatened to kill former Delhi chief minister Arvind Kejriwal and demanded ₹7 crore in extortion, according to an Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) lawmaker's police complaint.
The complaint said a person claiming to be a member of the gang threatened to kill Kejriwal and his daughter, Harshita, if the money was not paid.

Jarnail Singh, the lawmaker representing Tilak Nagar in the Delhi assembly, received threatening phone calls and WhatsApp messages, and a complaint was filed with the senior police superintendent in Mohali in AAP-ruled Punjab on November 6.
A case has been registered and assigned to Mohali's Cyber Crime Police Station for investigation.
Before Shroff, the gang targeted Bollywood stars Salman Khan, Ranveer Singh, Aamir Khan, and director Rohit Shetty.
Renowned Punjabi singer Sidhu Moosewala was assassinated in May 2022, and Maharashtra politician Baba Siddique was killed in October 2024.

items.title: Man jumps to death from Kanpur mall after girlfriend refuses marriage
points: A 36-year-old man allegedly died by suicide after jumping off the second floor of a mall in Kanpur following an argument with his girlfriend over marriage, police said on Thursday.
The incident took place at Rave Moti Mall in the posh Sarvodaya Nagar area on Wednesday evening.
The man, identified as Imtiyaz Riyaz alias Sikandar, was rushed to Regency Hospital, where doctors declared him dead.

Assistant Commissioner of Police (Swaroop Nagar) Jyoti Shri told PTI that Sikandar, who worked in Saudi Arabia, had been in a relationship with the woman, a relative's daughter, for nearly 10 years and wanted to marry her.
However, she had apparently become involved with another man while he was away, an official said.
On Wednesday evening, Sikandar arrived at the mall with two friends and called the woman there to discuss the matter.
An argument allegedly broke out after she declined his marriage proposal, following which he jumped from the second floor, the ACP said.

items.title: NYK charts the great reshuffling of global commodity trades
points: The global VLCC fleet will see a significant expansion despite the extraordinary earnings currently being enjoyed by tanker owners, with Japanese shipping giant Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK) forecasting the delivery of approximately 290 supertankers between…

NYK’s research group unveiled its latest shipping market outlook yesterday, predicting that the active VLCC fleet will increase from 909 vessels at the end of 2025 to 1,082 by the end of 2029, a rise of 19%.
The forecast assumes a substantial number of ageing vessels will leave the market, but deliveries are expected to be comparable to those witnessed during the shipping boom of the 2000s.
NYK’s research also anticipates a fundamental restructuring of global commodity trades over the coming decade.
Seaborne iron ore volumes are forecast to decline from 1.65bn tonnes in 2025 to 1.40bn tonnes in 2035 as Chinese steel production contracts.
However, increasing shipments from Guinea’s Simandou project are expected to support tonne-mile demand as Atlantic basin cargoes replace some Australian supplies.

items.title: Bloom Energy shares jump 13%: Can the AI power stock sustain its rally?
points: Bloom Energy shares rally 13% on Wednesday, November 11, after upbeat results and an improved revenue outlook from CoreWeave ease concerns about a slowdown in AI infrastructure spending.
(Sources: 24/7 Wall St, MarketWatch, BigGo Finance) The rally follows CoreWeave's third-quarter results, which show revenue of $3.66 billion, up 168% year on year.
The AI cloud computing company also reports a backlog of around $132.5 billion and raises its 2026 revenue forecast to $13 billion-$13.3 billion, signalling continued demand for AI infrastructure.
Despite Wednesday's 13% rally, Bloom Energy shares remain 39% below their June 22 record closing high of $345.85.
The stock had fallen 52% from that peak by November 5, marking the third time since its 2018 IPO that it had lost more than half its value from a previous high.
According to 24/7 Wall St, Bloom Energy has recorded 40 sessions in which its shares jumped at least 12% while trading 35% or more below their previous peak.

'Sad day for democracy': Bombay HC warns against criminalising constitutional right to protest
points: The Bombay high court has overturned an FIR against Nishkarsh Nimgade, highlighting the fundamental constitutional right to peaceful assembly during his protest over poor road conditions in Chandrapur district.
The court recognised this right as vital to the democratic fabric and stated that criminal charges shouldn't stifle non-violent protests.
Sparked by an accident linked to these conditions, the court condemned the prosecution of Nimgade as a misuse of legal resources.

He outlined a four-stage model of economic development related to invention and innovation.
While India has made progress in certain areas, it still lags in many aspects affecting citizens' lives.

items.title: The Australian in Indira's Tihar compound: When Sonia Gandhi carried lunch for Charles Sobhraj's accomplice
points: On Christmas Day in 1978, Sonia Gandhi brought a homemade lunch to Tihar Jail for her mother-in-law.
Indira Gandhi, a former Prime Minister, was imprisoned during a turbulent political period.
The meal was extended to include prison guards and a fellow inmate related to a notorious killer.
Despite resistance, Sonia felt compelled to keep family traditions alive during this difficult time.

items.title: Owaisi, Azad announce alliance for UP polls; send message to Akhilesh
points: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi and Nagina MP Chandrashekhar Azad formed an alliance named Samajik Parivartan Morcha.
They intend to challenge the BJP in the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.
Azad will be the chief ministerial candidate, aiming to unite marginalized communities for greater political representation.
The alliance invites other parties, like the Samajwadi Party and Congress, to join in this effort.
